define_simulation_graph: define a TensorFlow graph that connects a batch environment with a reinforcement learning algorithm and config
define_batch_env: create a batch of gym environments wrapped for in-graph execution with optional external process support
define_saver: create a TensorFlow saver that checkpoints global variables while excluding names matching regex patterns
define_network: build a recurrent cell network for a reinforcement learning agent with configurable policy and value layers
initialize_variables: initialize or restore TensorFlow variables from a checkpoint file in a given log directory
